extra.final_summary: The data had three main issues: (1) three rows with negative flipper_length_mm values (below minimum 170) were excluded as likely data entry errors; (2) three rows with body_mass_g values far above the maximum of 6500 grams (up to 5,050,000 g) were excluded as likely errors; (3) two 'sex' label variants (' male' and 'male ') were normalized to 'male' to match allowed labels. After fixes, the average body mass by species is: Adelie: 3,694.44 g, Chinstrap: 3,801.79 g, Gentoo: 5,173.33 g. The analysis used 47 rows after exclusions.
